description: The root document of an Open Factory definition.

agentDefaults.description: Execution settings that every agent inherits. idleTimeoutMinutes is not allowed here: set it per agent or per automation.

harness.description: Complete harness object for every agent: type and model are required. Set exactly one of model or harness.

machine.description: Default machine: the name of a file machines/<name>.yaml. It must be a Linux machine.

mcpServers.description: Default MCP servers for agents without their own mcpServers. A name must not also be in the factory-wide mcpServers.

model.description: Model shorthand for every agent. Set exactly one of model or harness.

secrets.description: Default secret names for agents without their own secrets.

workerHost.description: Default worker host. An empty value means the server default (server).

alias.description: Handle of the foreman in chat and on code hosts. It must not be blank and must be unique in the team. Default: the current alias of the factory, else a value made from name.

allowAgentMerge.description: If true, agents can call the merge tools of MCP servers through the control plane, and the audit log records each call. If false, the control plane refuses each merge call.

approvers.description: Emails of users or names of service accounts. If set, only they can resolve an approval, from every tool. Other members can still answer questions. Without a value, each team member can approve.

automations.description: Factory settings for automations. The automations themselves are files automations/<name>/automation.md.

githubOnboardingNotices.description: If true, Open Factory comments once on the issue or pull request when a GitHub account that cannot start work sends an event. If false, it ignores the event without a comment.

benchmarkRepoSubstitutions.description: Repositories that benchmark trials use in place of production repositories.

source.description: Repository to replace. It must be one of the repositories of the factory.

codeForge.description: Code host of the repository. Only GITHUB.

target.description: Repository that the trials use. It must not be one of the repositories of the factory.

codeForge.description: Code host of the repository. Only GITHUB.

cloudProviders.description: Cloud identity federation. Every run gets short-lived credentials for the declared clouds.

audiences.description: More audiences for which a run can get a token, for other services that accept OIDC tokens.

roleArn.description: ARN of the IAM role that the runs assume. It must start with arn: and contain at least 5 : characters.

projectNumber.description: Number of the Google Cloud project.

serviceAccountEmail.description: Service account that the credentials impersonate. Must be an email address.

workloadIdentityFederationPoolId.description: ID of the workload identity pool.

workloadIdentityFederationProviderId.description: ID of the provider in the workload identity pool.

codeForges.description: Code hosts of the repositories. If it is [], repositories must be empty.

credentialStrategy.description: Whose code-forge credentials the runs use. Agents inherit it. Without a value at any level, the strategy is EXECUTOR.

factoryConfigChecks.description: Pull requests that get the openfactory/definition check: main (pull requests to the production branch) or all (pull requests to every branch). Open Factory reads it from the active definition.

jira.description: Settings of the jira entry. Valid only when type is jira.

linear.description: Settings of the linear entry. Valid only when type is linear.

microsoft-teams.description: Settings of the microsoft-teams entry. Valid only when type is microsoft-teams.

autoRespondToThreadReplies.description: If true, a reply in the thread of a work item continues the work item. If false, a reply without a mention does not.

slack.description: Settings of the slack entry. Valid only when type is slack.

autoRespondToThreadReplies.description: If true, a reply in the thread of a work item continues the work item. If false, a reply without a mention does not.

type.description: Integration type. Each type can occur only once. linear and jira are mutually exclusive.

integrations.description: Chat and tracker integrations of the factory. If absent, the factory keeps its integrations. null or [] removes them all. When it is set, each slack, teams, linear or jira trigger needs its integration in the list.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Most open sessions that the factory can have at one time. A queued run waits while the factory is at its limit. Without a value, there is no limit.

mcpServers.description: Factory-wide MCP servers. Every agent gets them. A lower level must not declare the same name again.

networkPolicy.description: Outbound network policy of every run. An agent policy merges with it. Without a policy at any level, outbound access is unrestricted.

repositories.description: Repositories that the factory works on. It can be []. A repository can be listed only once (case-insensitive).

codeForge.description: Code host of the repository. Required when codeForges lists more than one value. If codeForges is set, the value must be in it. Default: the only codeForges value, else GITHUB.

name.description: Name of one repository: no /, space or tab.

owner.description: Owner of the repository. No spaces or tabs, no leading or trailing /, no //. For GITHUB, no /. For GITLAB, it can be a group path (acme/platform). For AZURE_DEVOPS, it is organization/project.

requireLinkedActor.description: If true, events from a forge, chat or tracker account that is not linked to an active team member are dropped. Custom webhooks, schedules, the API and MCP are not affected.

restrictFollowupsToStarter.description: If true, only the user who started a work item can send it follow-up messages. Other members can still resolve its inbox items.

scorerDefaults.description: Execution settings of the judge runs of every scorer and of the built-in Correctness Scorer of benchmarks. Without it, the judge uses the harness of agentDefaults.

harness.description: The harness of the judge runs, over the harness of agentDefaults.

machine.description: Machine of the judge runs: the name of a file machines/<name>.yaml. A scorer's machine replaces it.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers of the judge runs. A scorer's servers add to them. A scorer server with the same name replaces the server.

model.description: The model of the judge runs. It replaces the model of the harness.

secrets.description: Secret names of the judge runs. A scorer's secrets add to them.
Factory-wide secret names. Every agent gets them, and no level can remove them.

selfImprovement.description: Settings of the Self-improvement runs, which examine failed runs and propose changes.

analysisModel.description: The model that examines failed runs. The default is the model of the foreman.

failedRunThreshold.description: Number of distinct unreviewed failures of one agent that starts a Self-improvement run.

reviewerEmails.description: Emails of the reviewers. Required when reviewerType is custom, and allowed only then. Each entry must be an email address.

reviewerType.description: Who reviews a proposed change: admins (team admins), team (any team member), custom (the members in reviewerEmails) or none.

spendLimit.description: Model spend limit of the factory. Set daily, monthly or both.

daily.description: Most model spend in one day, in US dollars.

monthly.description: Most model spend in one month, in US dollars.

title: factory.yaml
